meta.name: anti-ui-slop
meta.description: Stop coding agents from shipping generic UI. Use UIZZE's 800,000+ real web and iOS screens to build product-specific interfaces, define a design contract, cover required states, and run a hard finish gate. Use for web or iOS UI design, implementation, redesign, critique, and pre-ship review in Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, and other coding agents.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用真实屏幕库生成精准的 UI 设计
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在 coding agent 中生成产品特定的界面而非通用模板。
copy.tagline_en: Generate precise UIs using a real-screen library
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to generate product-specific UI in coding agents instead of generic templates.

howto.what: Claude会用UIZZE的80万+真实网页和iOS屏幕作为参考，设计产品专属界面。它还会编写设计契约，覆盖加载、空、错误等状态，并通过最终检查门确保UI不再像通用AI生成。
howto.when: 当你要求Claude进行Web或iOS UI设计、实现、重设计、评审或发布前检查时触发。

say.text: 用UIZZE为这个应用首页找设计参考。
say.note: Claude会搜索UIZZE目录并展示相关屏幕。

say.text: 检查这个UI有没有通用样式问题。
say.note: 触发完成门检查，指出不符合真实设计决策的地方。

say.text: 为这个登录界面写一个设计契约。
say.note: Claude会定义屏幕任务、层级、允许组件和必需状态。

howto.what_en: Claude uses UIZZE's 800,000+ real web and iOS screens to build product-specific interfaces. It writes a design contract, covers required states (loading, empty, error, success, permission), and runs a hard finish gate to ensure the UI no longer looks like a generic coding-agent default.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to design, implement, redesign, critique, or pre-ship check a web or iOS UI.

say_en.text: Find design references on UIZZE for this app homepage.
say_en.note: Claude searches the UIZZE catalogue and shows relevant screens.

say_en.text: Check this UI for generic slop issues.
say_en.note: Runs the finish gate and points out mismatches with real design decisions.

say_en.text: Write a design contract for this login screen.
say_en.note: Claude defines screen job, hierarchy, allowed components, and required states.
